title: Attack logics, not outputs: Concept-based Property Attacks for Shortcut Elimination in Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.34923v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks (NNs) for computer vision are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, such that minuscule malicious changes to inputs may induce unintuitive outputs. One key approach to verify and mitigate such robustness issues is to falsify expected output behavior, which enables local robustness guarantees and adversarial training. Due to the black-box nature of NNs, current attacks only falsify a class of the final output, such as flipping from $\text{stop_sign}$ to $\neg \text{stop_sign}$. translated_title: 攻击逻辑而非输出：用于消除神经网络捷径的基于概念的属性攻击
translated_abstract: 用于计算机视觉的深度神经网络（NN）容易受到对抗攻击，即对输入进行微小的恶意修改就可能引发不直观的输出。验证和缓解此类鲁棒性问题的一个关键方法是对预期的输出行为进行证伪，这使得局部鲁棒性保证和对抗训练成为可能。由于神经网络的黑盒特性，当前的攻击只能证伪最终输出的某一类别，例如从 $\text{stop_sign}$ 翻转为 $\neg \text{stop_sign}$。在这项工作中，我们主张鲁棒性分析应更广泛地关注概念级推理中的逻辑不一致性，而不仅仅是输出误分类。我们通过基于概念的属性来形式化这一观点，即对人类可解释概念的约束，例如 $\text{red} \land \text{octogonal} \implies \text{stop_sign}$，并将对此类属性的证伪作为一种有原则的对抗攻击形式加以研究……
tldr: 本文提出基于概念的属性攻击方法，将对抗攻击的目标从证伪最终输出类别扩展到证伪概念级推理中的逻辑约束（如“红色∧八边形⟹停车标志”），从而以更有原则的方式检测并消除神经网络中的捷径学习问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes concept-based property attacks, shifting adversarial attacks from falsifying final output classes to falsifying logical constraints in concept-level reasoning (e.g., red ∧ octagonal ⟹ stop_sign), thereby providing a principled approach to detect and eliminate shortcut learning in neural networks.
